verdict.rationale: Apify documents first-party Docker base images for building Actors (its packaged scrapers) and says it uses them daily on the Apify Platform, so containerized scrapers are a product capability. The evidence shows these images only as a basis for Actors run on Apify's own platform. Nothing shows deploying the scraping service as a self-run Docker container in your own production environment. Missing for 10: documentation of self-hosted or production Docker deployment outside the Apify platform, Dockerfile/deployment guidance details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use

citations.quote: we already created base images that you can freely use. We use them every day on the Apify Platform.
Apify is all about Actors—a new way to package your code to make it easy to share, integrate, and build upon.
